mechanism: Perphenazine may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of fexofenadine, increasing fexofenadine plasma concentrations and QT prolongation risk; additive anticholinergic effects may also occur.
action: Monitor for QT prolongation, excessive sedation, and anticholinergic effects; consider alternative antihistamine or antipsychotic if possible; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
